phoneDirectoryRequest.requestedBehavior: Use Choose workspace to select and use folders in the phone's shared storage.

phoneDirectoryRequest.securityConstraint: ANDROID_SECURITY_MODEL.md requires app-private storage by default, a URI-aware adapter with grant-revocation and traversal tests for SAF, and no assumption of broad shared-storage permission.
phoneDirectoryRequest.nextWork: Implement a scoped SAF-backed workspace filesystem adapter; do not add MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE as a shortcut.
